19601.meaning1: who has committed a theft; who has committed a crime
19601.commentary: (MNa) katakammehī'ti katacorakammehi. corā kira katakammā yaṃ nesaṃ devataṃ āyācitvā kammaṃ nipphannaṃ, tassa upahāratthāya manusse māretvā galalohit'ādīni gaṇhanti. te aññesu manussesu māriyamānesu kolāhalā uppajjissanti, pabbajitaṃ pariyesanto nāma n'atthī'ti maññamānā bhikkhū gahetvā mārenti. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: theyyasattho nāma corā katakammā vā honti akatakammā vā, rājānaṃ vā theyyaṃ gacchanti suṅkaṃ vā pariharanti.

bhūtapubbaṃ, bhante, bhikkhū ratt'andhakāratimisāyaṃ piṇḍāya carantā candanikam'pi pavisanti, oligalle'pi papatanti, kaṇṭak'āvāṭam'pi ārohanti, suttam'pi gāviṃ ārohanti, māṇavehi'pi samāgacchanti katakammehi'pi akatakammehi'pi, mātugāmo'pi te asaddhammena nimanteti.

19604.meaning1: dependent on contact of past action

19605.meaning1: who has done the job; who has done what needs to be done; who has fulfilled the obligation; epithet of an arahant

examples.text: khīṇ'āsavassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanassa samma'd'aññāvimuttassa ayam'anudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya
yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti

19606.commentary: (ANa) akatakalyāṇo'ti-ādīsu kalyāṇaṃ vuccati puññakammaṃ, taṃ akataṃ etenā'ti akatakalyāṇo. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatapāpo hoti akataluddo akatakibbiso katakalyāṇo katakusalo katabhīruttāṇo. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.

19607.meaning1: finished the job; done what needs to be done; epithet of an arahant
19607.commentary: (ANa) katakicco'ti catūhi maggehi kiccaṃ katvā ṭhito. (DHPa) catūhi maggehi soḷasannaṃ kiccānaṃ katattā katakiccaṃ

examples.text: pāragū anupādāno, katakicco anāsavo, tuṭṭho āyukkhayā hoti, mutto āghātanā yathā.
jhāyiṃ virajam'āsīnaṃ, katakiccaṃ anāsavaṃ, pāraguṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūhi, avijjāya pabhedanaṃ.

19608.meaning1: who has done wrong; who has done dirty things; who has committed sin

examples.text: kiṃ sundarikā karissati, kiṃ payāgo kiṃ bāhukā nadī, veriṃ katakibbisaṃ naraṃ, na hi naṃ sodhaye pāpakamminaṃ.
puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo katapāpo kataluddo katakibbiso. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.

19609.meaning1: who has done good; who has made merit

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatapāpo hoti akataluddo akatakibbiso katakalyāṇo katakusalo katabhīruttāṇo. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.
yo'pi c'ettha katakusalo hoti, tam'pi ñātirogabhogabyasan'ādīnaṃ aññatarena byasanena samannāgataṃ disvā vā sutvā vā tesaṃ abhāve'pi vaṭṭadukkhaṃ anatikkantattā, dukkhito'va ayan'ti.

19610.meaning2: a massage device made of a string with small balls

19611.meaning1: how many factors?; how many components?

examples.text: paṭhamaṃ pan'āvuso, jhānaṃ kat'aṅgavippahīnaṃ kat'aṅgasamannāgatan'ti? paṭhamaṃ kho, āvuso, jhānaṃ pañc'aṅgavippahīnaṃ, pañc'aṅgasamannāgataṃ.

19612.meaning1: possessing how many factors?; endowed with how many components?

examples.text: paṭhamaṃ pan'āvuso, jhānaṃ kat'aṅgavippahīnaṃ kat'aṅgasamannāgatan'ti?

19613.meaning1: how many factors are abandoned?; how many components are given up?
19613.commentary: (MNa) kat'aṅgavippahīnan'ti idha pana kiṃ pucchati? nirodhaṃ samāpajjanakena bhikkhunā upakārānupakārāni aṅgāni jānitabbāni, tāni pucchissāmī'ti pucchati, vissajjanaṃ pan'ettha pākaṭam'eva. iti heṭṭhā nirodhapādakaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ gahitaṃ, upari tassa anantarapaccayaṃ n'evasaññā-n'āsaññ'āyatan-asamāpattiṃ pucchissati. antarā pana cha samāpattiyo saṃkhittā, nayaṃ vā dassetvā vissaṭṭhā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: paṭhamaṃ pan'āvuso, jhānaṃ kat'aṅgavippahīnaṃ kat'aṅgasamannāgatan'ti?

19616.meaning2: having raised one's hands in salutation

19617.commentary: (SNa) kataññutā'ti katajānanaṃ. (KHPa) kataññutā nāma appassa vā bahussa vā yena kenaci katassa upakārassa punappunaṃ anussaraṇabhāvena jānanatā. apica nerayik'ādi-dukkha-parittāṇato puññāni eva pāṇīnaṃ bah'ūpakārāni, tato tesam'pi upakār'ānussaraṇatā kataññutā'ti veditabbā. sā sappurisehi pasaṃsanīy'ādi-nānappakāra-vises'ādhigama-hetuto maṅgalan'ti vuccati. āha ca dve'me, bhikkhave, puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ. katame dve? yo ca pubbakārī yo ca kataññū katavedī'ti (a. ni. 2.120).

examples.text: gāravo ca nivāto ca, santuṭṭhi ca kataññutā, kālena dhammassavanaṃ, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
siyā kho, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ jarasiṅgāle yā kāci kataññutā kataveditā, na tv'eva idh'ekacce sakyaputtiyapaṭiññe siyā yā kāci kataññutā kataveditā.

19618.meaning1: gratefulness and thankfulness; gratitude and appreciativeness

examples.text: katamehi catūhi? kāyasucaritena, vacīsucaritena, manosucaritena, kataññutākataveditā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yath'ābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge'ti.
tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kataññuno bhavissāma katavedino, na ca no amhesu appakam'pi kataṃ nassissatī'ti. evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban'ti.
kataññunā me bhavituṃ vaṭṭatī'ti ekaṃ satasahassaṃ gāhāpetvā cūḷaseṭṭhissa samīpaṃ gato

19620.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of kata
19620.commentary: (ANa) katañ'ca katato jānissāma, akatañ'ca akatato'ti sakaladivasaṃ idaṃ nāma kammaṃ katvā āgatānaṃ, upaḍḍhadivasaṃ idaṃ nāma kammaṃ katvā āgatānaṃ, nikkammānaṃ gehe nisinnānaṃ idaṃ nāma dātuñca evañ'ca kātuṃ vaṭṭatī'ti evaṃ jānissāma.

examples.text: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yo so bhattu abbhantaro antojano, dāsā'ti vā pessā'ti vā kammakarā'ti vā, tesaṃ katañ'ca katato jānāti akatañ'ca akatato jānāti, gilānakānañ'ca bal'ābalaṃ jānāti khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyañ'c'assa paccaṃsena saṃvibhajati.

19621.meaning2: doing of, fact of having done

examples.text: ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena m'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantī'ti? katattā ca, brāhmaṇa, akatattā ca.
iti sakaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ katattā, nikkaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ pakatiyā pariniṭṭhitattā, evan'taṃ navavidhaṃ pubbakiccaṃ pariniṭṭhitaṃ hoti.

19622.grammar: nt, abstr, abl sg of katatta (+gen)
19622.meaning1: because of doing; from the fact of having done

examples.text: ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena m'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantī'ti? katattā ca, brāhmaṇa, akatattā ca.
iti sakaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ katattā, nikkaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ pakatiyā pariniṭṭhitattā, evan'taṃ navavidhaṃ pubbakiccaṃ pariniṭṭhitaṃ hoti.

19626.meaning1: friendly reception made (by); kind welcome (of); hospitality shown (by)

examples.text: tato sabbam'pi therena dinnakaṃ cetiyaghare ekaṃ varapotthakacitt'attharaṇaṃ na agghati. tato āhaṃsu, therena katapaṭisanthāro sukato codetuṃ vā sāretuṃ vā na labbhā, gīvā vā avahāro vā n'atthī'ti. evaṃ mah'ānisaṃso paṭisanthāro'ti sallakkhetvā kattabbo paṇḍitena bhikkhunā'ti.

19627.meaning1: familiar with others' doctrines; well acquainted with the beliefs of others; skilled in another's dogma
19627.commentary: (MNa) kataparappavāde'ti viññātaparappavāde c'eva parehi saddhiṃ katavādaparicaye ca.

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? idh'āhaṃ, bho, passāmi ekacce khattiyapaṇḍite nipuṇe kataparappavāde vālavedhirūpe, te bhindantā maññe caranti paññāgatena diṭṭhigatāni.

19628.meaning2: completed the preparations; done the arrangement

19629.meaning2: having practised or made acquaintance with

19630.meaning1: fact of being acquainted; fact of being familiar

examples.text: sahapaṃsukīḷikā'ti etena nesaṃ dīgharattaṃ kataparicayabhāvaṃ dasseti. samāgaccheyyun'ti sālāya vā rukkhamūle vā sammukhībhāvaṃ gaccheyyuṃ.

19634.meaning1: who has done evil; who has done wrong

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo katapāpo kataluddo katakibbiso. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.

19635.meaning1: who has made merit; who has done good; has gained spiritual wealth
19635.commentary: (DNa) katapuñño'sī'ti kappasatasahassaṃ abhinīhārasampannosī'ti dasseti. katapuñño'sī'ti ca ettāvatā vissattho mā pamādam'āpajji, atha kho padhānam'anuyuñja. evañ'hi anuyutto khippaṃ hohisi anāsavo, dhammasaṅgītikāle arahattaṃ pāpuṇissasi. na hi mādisassa katapāricariyā nipphalā nāma hotī'ti dasseti. (DHPa) katapuñño'ti nānappakārassa puññassa kattā.

examples.text: idha modati pecca modati, katapuñño ubhay'attha modati, so modati so pamodati, disvā kammavisuddhim'attano.
sobhati idaṃ āyasmato kosiyassa, yathā taṃ pubbe katapuññassa. manussā'pi kiñci'd'eva rāmaṇeyyakaṃ disvā evam'āhaṃsu, sobhati vata bho yathā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānan'ti.

19636.meaning1: fact of having made merit; fact of having done good; fact of having spiritual wealth

examples.text: patirūpadesavāso ca, pubbe ca katapuññatā, attasammāpaṇidhi ca, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo yam'enaṃ hatthidammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāreti, yadi vā katapubbaṃ yadi vā akatapubbaṃ, taṃ aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto suṇāti. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo sotā hoti.

19638.meaning2: to be done or made; to be carried out; what is to be done, what should be done

19639.meaning2: something manufactured (e.g. cloth or worked metal); something not in its natural state
19639.commentary: (VINa) katabhaṇḍan'ti kataṃbhaṇḍaṃ kambala-kojava-santhat'ādiṃ yaṃ kiñci antamaso suttakena baddhamattam'pi.

examples.text: tiyojanaṃ vās'ādhippāyo gantvā tato paraṃ harati, acchinnaṃ paṭilabhitvā harati, nissaṭṭhaṃ paṭilabhitvā harati, aññaṃ harāpeti katabhaṇḍaṃ, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

19641.meaning1: finished eating a meal; completed taking food

examples.text: imāni cattāri'pi kāraṇāni dīgharattaṃ tathāgatena katān'eva. ten'assa imesaṃ katabhāvaṃ sadevako loko iminā kāraṇena jānātū'ti suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ nibbattati.

19644.meaning1: who has made a refuge from fear; who has made a protection against terror

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatapāpo hoti akataluddo akatakibbiso katakalyāṇo katakusalo katabhīruttāṇo. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.

19645.meaning2: which, what, which of the many

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa, jighacchāya pipāsāya
evam'pi viggayha vivādayanti, bālo paro akusalo'ti c'āhu, sacco nu vādo katamo imesaṃ, sabb'eva h'īme kusalā vadānā.

19646.meaning1: and what, friends?; and which, brothers?

examples.text: katamañ'c'āvuso, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ? jāti'pi dukkhā, jarā'pi dukkhā, maraṇam'pi dukkhaṃ, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā'pi dukkhā, yam'p'icchaṃ na labhati tam'pi dukkhaṃ, saṃkhittena, pañc'upādānakkhandhā dukkhā.
tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, iti kira bho rūpaṃ anattā, vedanā… saññā… saṅkhārā… viññāṇaṃ anattā, anattakatāni kammāni katam'attānaṃ phusissantī'ti.

19648.meaning2: as soon as something has done

examples.text: adāsi me akāsi me, ñātimittā sakhā ca me, petānaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ dajjā, pubbe katam'anussaraṃ.

19650.grammar: pron, masc & nt loc sg of katama, interr

examples.text: iminā tvaṃ, puṇṇa, mayā saṃkhittena ovādena ovadito katamasmiṃ janapade viharissasī'ti? atthi, bhante, sunāparanto nāma janapado, tatth'āhaṃ viharissāmī'ti.

19651.meaning1: what has been done is enough; that is sufficient

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahako ārāmaṃ sampāpuṇitvā āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca, alam'ettāvatā, bhante therā'ti? alam'ettāvatā, āvuso mahaka! katam'ettāvatā, āvuso mahaka! pūjitam'ettāvatā, āvuso mahako'ti.

siyā kho pana, bhikkhave, tumhākaṃ evam'assa, hir'ottappen'amha samannāgatā, alam'ettāvatā katam'ettāvatā, anuppatto no sāmaññ'attho, n'atthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyan'ti tāvataken'eva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.

19652.meaning1: in which direction? which way? where?
19652.meaning2: in which direction? which way? where?

examples.text: api ca, mahārāja, katamena taṃ nemi, yena vā pāpakammā pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, yena vā kalyāṇakammā kalyāṇakammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti? ubhayen'eva maṃ, mātali, nehī'ti.

atha kho suddh'āvāso paccekabrahmā katamorakatissakaṃ bhikkhuṃ ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
seyyathā'pi nāma daḷhadhammā dhanuggaho susikkhito katahattho katayoggo kat'ūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasiren'eva tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya.

19657.meaning1: which of the two?; which of the many?

examples.text: iminā ca tvaṃ puṇṇa, mayā saṃkhittena ovādena ovadito katarasmiṃ janapade viharissasī'ti? imin'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena ovādena ovadito, atthi sunāparanto nāma janapado, tatth'āhaṃ viharissāmī'ti.

19661.meaning1: preparation of the made target; prepared target

examples.text: lahukena asanenā'ti anto susiraṃ katvā tūl'ādīhi pūretvā katalakkhaparikammena sallahukakaṇḍena. evaṃ katañ'hi ekausabhagāmī dve usabhāni'pi gacchati… aṭṭh'usabhagāmī soḷasa usabhāni'pi gacchati. appakasirenā'ti niddukkhena.

19662.meaning1: painted with lac; decorated with lipstick

examples.text: tassa kira kāyo setapokkharasadiso devanagare ussāpitarajatatoraṇaṃ viya sobhati, sīsaṃ pan'assa kāḷavaṇṇa-indanīlamayaṃ viya, massu'pi candamaṇḍale kāḷamegharāji viya khāyati, akkhīni nīl'uppalasadisāni, nāsā rajatapanāḷikā viya suvaṭṭitā suparisuddhā, hatthapādatalāni c'eva mukhañ'ca katalākhārasaparikammaṃ viya sobhati. ativiya sobhaggappatto brāhmaṇassa attabhāvo.
puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo katapāpo kataluddo katakibbiso. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.

19667.meaning2: (of grass or leaves) spread; layer; scattering

examples.text: nikkhagaṇānan'ti suvaṇṇanikkhasatānaṃ. cayo'ti santānato katasannicayo. dhaññagaṇānan'ti dhaññasakaṭasatānaṃ.

19669.meaning1: who has completed the ascetic task; who has fulfilled monkhood

examples.text: akathaṃkathissa tusitassa, vantalok'āmisassa muditassa, katasamaṇassa manujassa, antimasārīrassa narassa, anopamassa virajassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.

19670.meaning1: who has duly considered; who has done a proper investigation

examples.text: yasmā ca anicc'ādi-vasena akatasammasanassa dibbāya sotadhātuyā bheravaṃ saddaṃ suṇato, pubbenivās'ānussatiyā bherave khandhe anussarato, dibbena cakkhunā bheravam'pi rūpaṃ passato bhayasantāso uppajjati, na anicc'ādi-vasena katasammasanassa tasmā abhiññaṃ pattassa bhayavinodanahetusampādan'attham'pi idaṃ idh'eva dassitaṃ.

19671.meaning2: who has fulfilled the ascetic life

19672.meaning2: who has performed the duties of an ascetic

19673.meaning2: mat made of some kind of stalks

19677.meaning2: ?? for the sake of the benefit of making debate

examples.text: siyā kho, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ jarasiṅgāle yā kāci kataññutā kataveditā, na tv'eva idh'ekacce sakyaputtiyapaṭiññe siyā yā kāci kataññutā kataveditā.

19679.commentary: (ANa) kataññū katavedī'ti iminā mayhaṃ katan'ti tena katakammaṃ ñatvā viditaṃ pākaṭaṃ katvā paṭikaraṇakapuggalo.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kataññuno bhavissāma katavedino, na ca no amhesu appakam'pi kataṃ nassissatī'ti. evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban'ti.

19680.commentary: (SNa) katahattho'ti usabhappamāṇe'pi vāl'aggaṃ vijjhituṃ samatthabhāvena katahattho. (ANa) katahattho'ti eko sippam'eva uggaṇhāti, katahattho na hoti ayaṃ pana katahattho ciṇṇavasibhāvo.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpo javo ahosi, seyyathā'pi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho kat'ūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cattāro daḷhadhammā dhanuggahā susikkhitā katahatthā kat'ūpāsanā catuddisā ṭhitā assu.
okāsa! sammajjanī, sammajjanakaraṇaṃ kataṃ kiṃ?
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

19682.meaning1: commissions and omissions (of); what is done and not done (by)

examples.text: na paresaṃ vilomāni, na paresaṃ kat'ākataṃ, attano'va avekkheyya, katāni akatāni ca.

19683.meaning1: shaped and unshaped; made and unmade; wrought and unwrought

examples.text: nānappakārakaṃ nāma katam'pi akatam'pi kat'ākatam'pi. kataṃ nāma sīs'ūpagaṃ gīv'ūpagaṃ hatth'ūpagaṃ pād'ūpagaṃ kaṭ'ūpagaṃ. akataṃ nāma ghanakataṃ vuccati. kat'ākataṃ nāma tadubhayaṃ.
samāpajjeyyā'ti katena kataṃ cetāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. katena akataṃ cetāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. katena kat'ākataṃ cetāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

19684.meaning1: who has made an aspiration; (comm) who has made an accumulation of merit
19684.meaning2: who has formed a resolution or an aspiration

examples.text: tadāha sabbaññuvaro mah'esī, ānandabhaddaṃ madhurassarena, ye pubbabuddhesu kat'ādhikārā, aladdhamokkhā jinasāsanesu.

19686.meaning1: how many benefits? how many advantages?

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, cunda, vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, ime pan'āvuso, cattāro sukhallik'ānuyoge anuyuttānaṃ viharataṃ kati phalāni kat'ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā'ti?

19688.meaning1: who has done wrong; who has made a mistake

examples.text: idāni yasmā yaṃ tena pāpakammaṃ kataṃ, taṃ vipaccamānaṃ ativiya dukkhavipākaṃ hoti, tasm'āssa taṃ vipākaṃ dassetuṃ kat'āparādhaṃ viya puttaṃ anukampakā mātāpitaro dayālukena cittena sudinnaṃ paribhāsanto varaṃ te moghapurisā'ti-ādim'āha.

19689.meaning2: who has formed a resolution or an aspiration

19690.meaning2: who has formed a resolution or an aspiration

examples.text: atha kho so māṇavako yena brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā brahm'āyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, kat'āvakāso kho'mhi bhavatā samaṇena gotamena. yassa'dāni bhavaṃ kālaṃ maññatī'ti.
diṭṭhadhammahit'atthāya, samparāyasukhāya ca, kat'āvakāsā pucchāma, yaṃ kiñci abhipatthitan'ti.
atha kho, bhikkhave, brahmā sahampati kat'āvakāso kho'mhi bhagavatā dhammadesanāyā'ti maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth'ev'antaradhāyi.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, tvaṃ vīsativass'uddesiko'pi paṇṇavīsativass'uddesiko'pi hatthismim'pi katāvī assasmim'pi katāvī rathasmim'pi katāvī dhanusmim'pi katāvī tharusmim'pi katāvī ūrubalī bāhubalī alam'atto saṅgām'āvacaro'ti?
kati jāgarataṃ suttā, kati suttesu jāgarā, katīhi rajaṃ ādeti, katīhi parisujjhatī'ti.
katihi nu kho, bhante, dhammehi tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharatī'ti?

19696.meaning1: consisting of how many parts?; composed of how many factors?

examples.text: paṭhamaṃ pan'āvuso, jhānaṃ katiaṅgikan'ti? paṭhamaṃ kho, āvuso, jhānaṃ pañc'aṅgikaṃ. idh'āvuso, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vitakko ca vattati, vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañ'ca citt'ek'aggatā ca.
